title: Constructing Options with Default
goal: Choose the most efficient method for falling back to default values.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Standard Traits

hints: unwrap_or expects an owned value T, while unwrap_or_else expects a closure/function FnOnce() `-> T`.
unwrap_or_default cleanly constructs the Default value lazily without taking closure arguments.
explanation: `opt.unwrap_or_default()` is the correct and idiomatic way to lazily construct a default value when an `Option` is `None`. `unwrap_or` expects an owned value, so passing `String::default` (a function item) fails type checking. `unwrap_or_else` expects a closure or function, so passing `String::default()` (an evaluated `String`) also causes a type error.
